title: Cr. & Sp. Br. Registry - re Cornelis A. Boonekamp reports loss of Dutch passport

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 2769
Date __/__/__

April 24 33.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter
No.1001 of April 5, 1933, and to inform you that
Cornelis Boonekamp, a Netherlands subject, is at
present residing at No. 686 Avenue Joffre, Room
No. 10.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
〔此处为手写签名〕
Officer i/c Special Branch.

J. Van den Berg, Esq.,
Netherlands Consulate-General.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 D 2769
日期 __/__/__

1933年4月24日。

先生：

谨此提及阁下1933年4月5日第1001号来函，并告知您，荷兰籍公民科内利斯·布恩坎普（Cornelis Boonekamp）现居住于霞飞路686号10室。

此致
敬礼

〔此处为手写签名〕
特别股主管警官。

J. Van den Berg 先生，
荷兰驻上海总领事馆。

Form No. 2

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C & S. B. REGISTRY File No. 2709）
Special Branch S.A. Station
Date April 24, 1933.

REPORT

Subject (in full) Cornelis Boonekamp.

Made by D.S. Moore Forwarded by （签名：D.S.M）

Regarding attached letter from the Netherlands
Consulate-General seeking information concerning the where-
abouts of one Cornelis Boonekamp, a Netherlands subject.
Enquiries made reveal that the individual in question re-
sides at 686 Avenue Joffre, Room No10 where he assists in
the operation of a concern known as the International Trans-
lation Bureau.

（签名：W.S. Moore D.S.）
Officer i/o Special Branch.

（批注手写体：File / MS）
page_data.zh:
表格第2号
G. 25,000-1-33

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股登记处 档案号 2709）
特别股 A 巡捕房分站
日期 1933年4月24日。

报告

当事人（全名） 科内利斯·布恩坎普（Cornelis Boonekamp）。

制作人 D.S. Moore 转呈人 （签名：D.S.M）

关于附上的荷兰总领事馆来函，该函寻求有关荷兰籍公民科内利斯·布恩坎普（Cornelis Boonekamp）下落的信息。经查询显示，该人居住在霞飞路686号10室，并在一家名为“国际翻译局”（International Translation Bureau）的机构中协助运营工作。

（签名：W.S. Moore D.S.）
特别股主管警官。

（批注手写体：归档 / MS）

Memorandum.
POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL,
Shanghai ____ 4. ____ 193 __
To O.C. S.B.

The file re G. Bonekamp
has been lost. Enquiries
were made at 'A' Division
to whom it was sent
on 27.8.31, and Stations,
but the file could
not be found.

O.R. 6/4
APR. 6 1933
S41 Please endeavour
to trace Bonekamp and
report result.
M.S.
page_data.zh:
备忘录。
警务处，
工部局，
上海 ____ 4. ____ 193 __
致 特别股主管警官。

关于 G. Bonekamp 的档案
已遗失。曾向
于1931年8月27日收到该档案的
“A”分区及各分站进行查询，
但未能找到该档案。

O.R. 6/4
1933年4月6日
S41 请设法查找 Bonekamp 并报告结果。
M.S.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 1001.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
N. D 2709
Rec 6 / 4 / 33

SHANGHAI, 5th April 1933.

Sir,

I would be much obliged to be informed if possible
of the present address of Cornelis BOONEKAMP, a Nether-
lands subject, whose last known address was at 628 Ave.
Joffre.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Chinese Secretary
for Consul-General.

T.P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

Reg. Please attach
file.
〔签名〕
APR 6 1933

SHANGHAI: 26th April 1933

Sir,

I wish to acknowledge the receipt

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
